title: Machine Metacognition: Latent-Space Uncertainty for Neural Networks
summary: Neural networks are systematically overconfident, especially on the cases that matter most. Drawing on human metacognition research, this project uses k-nearest-neighbour analysis of penultimate-layer activations to produce a 'neighbourhood consistency' score — a second-order uncertainty signal grounded in the network's familiarity with each input. Combined with softmax outputs, this raises melanoma classification AUC from 0.94 to 0.97 and dramatically improves sensitivity to high-confidence errors.
